notes: Two taḥwīl branches (Hisham to Sadaqa; Nasr to al-Walid) meet at «جميعا قالا حدثنا محمد»; that tail is shared.

«- قال هشام محمد بن عبد الله الشعيثي -» names a different transmitter at the same place: a variant, not a route. It is an editorial-style remark; a reviewer should confirm it is a variant and not a gloss.
«عن أبيه» names al-Lajlaj's father only by relation (rule 7).
